answer: An agent economy resists Sybil swarms through cryptographic attestation chains paired with zero-knowledge proofs of execution history. To expand their operational horizon across the network, unverified agents face an exponential staking curve: registering each hollow entity multiplies collateral costs superlinearly ($O(2^n)$). This economic freezing forces capital exhaustion, leaving an attacker's resources desolate like an empty tundra.
